title: Radiographer fracture detection with and without AI assistance in prospective emergency department use
_abs_err: springer: Client Challenge (bot check) from citation-needed.springer.c; page: Client Challenge (bot check) from www.nature.com
zh_title: 放射技师前瞻性使用AI骨折检测的真实世界评估
summary: 单急诊科三个月前瞻部署中，13名放射技师读取2496例肌骨检查，AI辅助使准确率由97.6%小幅升至98.0%。
key_points: 2496例连续检查、2496次配对读片
AI单独敏感度75.6%，隐匿骨折仅46.2%
技师基线敏感度91.6%，AI辅助净纠正10例
reason: 前瞻性真实部署、样本数千且报告工作流效果，属重要档
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) systems for fracture detection perform strongly in controlled settings, but prospective real-world evidence is limited. In a three-month deployment in one emergency department, thirteen radiographers in a radiographer-led screening programme independently interpreted 2496 consecutive musculoskeletal examinations (one radiographer per examination), reviewed output from a commercial deep-learning system, then recorded a final decision, giving 2496 paired reads against a radiologist reference standard. Standalone AI sensitivity was 75.6%, falling to 46.2% for subtle fractures, below the radiographers’ baseline sensitivity of 91.6%. Radiographers’ baseline accuracy was high (97.6%; specificity 99.0%) and improved modestly with AI assistance (98.0%; exact McNemar p = 0.0064). With AI assistance, radiographers corrected 11 errors and introduced 1, a net gain of 10 cases. Subgroup gains were directionally consistent but not significant after correction. Radiographers changed their decision in only 11 of 729 discordant cases, and most negative interactions were correct AI recommendations not adopted. No or incomplete AI output was returned for 8.8% of acquired examinations. AI assistance delivered a small, selective benefit arising from complementary rather than superior algorithmic performance. Operational reliability proved as consequential as diagnostic accuracy, and behavioural inferences rest on few events. Downstream clinical outcomes were not measured.
zh_abstract: 用于骨折检测的人工智能（AI）系统在受控环境中表现强劲，但前瞻性真实世界证据有限。在一个急诊科为期三个月的部署中，13名放射技师在由放射技师主导的筛查项目中独立解读了2496次连续的肌肉骨骼检查（每次检查由一名放射技师解读），审查了商业深度学习系统的输出，然后记录最终决定，从而产生了2496次与放射科医生参考标准配对的判读。独立AI的敏感度为75.6%，对于细微骨折降至46.2%，低于放射技师的基线敏感度91.6%。放射技师的基线准确率高（97.6%；特异度99.0%），并在AI辅助下略有提高（98.0%；精确McNemar p = 0.0064）。在AI辅助下，放射技师纠正了11个错误并引入了1个错误，净增加10例。亚组获益方向一致，但校正后不显著。放射技师仅在729例不一致病例中的11例改变了决定，大多数负向交互是未采纳正确的AI建议。8.8%的已采集检查返回了无AI输出或不完整AI输出。AI辅助带来了小幅、选择性的获益，其来源于互补而非优越的算法性能。操作可靠性与诊断准确性同样重要，而行为推断仅基于少数事件。未测量下游临床结局。

title: Masked Position Modeling as a Pre-Training Strategy for Foundational Deformable Image Registration Models.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: 掩码位置建模：可变形图像配准基础模型预训练策略
summary: IEEE TMI论文提出MPM-Reg，用掩码位置建模预训练纯Transformer可变形配准模型，实现跨模态、跨解剖部位的迁移。
key_points: 指出配准任务缺乏合适预训练方案，ViT基础模型应用受限
提出模态无关的掩码位置建模训练范式MPM-Reg
目标是构建可跨模态与解剖区域迁移的配准基础模型
reason: 方法有新意且发表于同行评审期刊，但摘要未显示外部验证或公开权重
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] The core objective of deformable image registration (DIR), estimating a displacement vector field that aligns two images, is fundamentally the same across imaging modalities and anatomical regions. Although this shared objective should imply the use of foundation models, most deep learning approaches for DIR operate within narrow domain-specific settings. Vision Transformers (ViTs) are the predominant choice for foundation models in many image processing tasks due to their excellent generalization capabilities and robustness to domain shifts. However, their use remains largely underexplored for DIR, which we attribute to a lack of suitable pre-training schemes. To address this need, we introduce MPM-Reg, a transferable, modality-agnostic training paradigm based on masked position modeling (MPM), enabling the use of fully transformer-based models as foundation models for image registration. Unlike conventional masked data modeling, which predicts the content of masked image patches, MPM masks the positional information and predicts the spatial relationship between image patches. Initially, we employ MPM on single images, which naturally aligns self-supervised pre-training of ViTs with the downstream registration task. Subsequently, we extend MPM to predict the positions of target patches within source images, re-formulating DIR through the lens of MPM. Experiments across eleven diverse datasets demonstrate MPM-Reg's competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Crucially, MPM-Reg benefits from heterogeneous multi-domain data, which degrades the performance of existing methods, paving the way for scalable foundation models for DIR.
zh_abstract: [IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging] 可变形图像配准（DIR）的核心目标是估计一个使两幅图像对齐的位移向量场，这一目标在成像模态和解剖区域之间从根本上相同。尽管这一共同目标应意味着使用基础模型，但大多数用于 DIR 的深度学习方法仍在狭窄的特定领域设置中运行。视觉 Transformer（ViT）因其出色的泛化能力以及对领域偏移的鲁棒性，在许多图像处理任务中是基础模型的主要选择。然而，它们在 DIR 中的使用仍很大程度上未被充分探索，我们将其归因于缺乏合适的预训练方案。为满足这一需求，我们提出 MPM-Reg，一种基于掩码位置建模（MPM）的可迁移、模态无关的训练范式，使完全基于 Transformer 的模型能够作为图像配准的基础模型。与预测掩码图像块内容的传统掩码数据建模不同，MPM 掩蔽位置信息并预测图像块之间的空间关系。首先，我们在单幅图像上使用 MPM，这自然地将 ViT 的自监督预训练与下游配准任务对齐。随后，我们将 MPM 扩展为预测源图像中目标图像块的位置，通过 MPM 的视角重新表述 DIR。在十一个多样化数据集上的实验表明，MPM-Reg 与最先进基线相比具有有竞争力的性能。关键是，MPM-Reg 受益于异构多领域数据，而这些数据会降低现有方法的性能，从而为可扩展的 DIR 基础模型铺平道路。

summary: 注册一项 6000 例干预性试验，评估 AI 报告辅助纵向肺结节管理能否减少良性病理的肺切除。
key_points: 对真实序列 CT 做结节匹配与变化测量
主要终点为 24 个月内良性病理肺切除比例
同时评估诊断延迟、分期与并发症
reason: 大规模前瞻性干预试验并设定临床结局终点，但尚无结果，未达里程碑档。
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology; conditions: Pulmonary Nodules, Lung Neoplasms; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 6000; status: RECRUITING] Patients with indeterminate lung nodules often face a choice between continued CT surveillance and invasive investigation. This trial compares management with or without access to an AI report that matches nodules across real serial CT scans, measures change, and estimates validated malignancy or invasiveness risks. The principal question is whether offering the report reduces lung resections that yield benign pathology over 24 months. Diagnostic delay, cancer stage, treatment opportunity, complications, and longer-term cancer outcomes are also assessed.

title: Patient-specific rubric-based evaluation of large language models across longitudinal cancer care
zh_title: 面向纵向肿瘤照护的患者特异性 LLM 评测基准
summary: 发布鼻咽癌纵向病程基准 NPC-RubricBench，用患者特异性评分细则评测 30 个大语言模型。
key_points: 取自两家中心 405 例患者的纵向病历
覆盖六个照护阶段的 941 个患者-阶段单元
结论：诊断强不代表下游照护表现好
reason: 大规模纵向基准与多模型评测有新意，但为预印本且未说明公开情况，属值得一看档。
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway. Here we introduce NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark for evaluating multistage clinical reasoning across the cancer care continuum, using nasopharyngeal carcinoma as a defined disease context. Curated from longitudinal records of 405 patients across two cancer centers, the benchmark comprises 941 patient-phase units across six sequential care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria spanning five evaluation dimensions, with each assessment strictly restricted to decision-time clinical evidence. Evaluating 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs revealed that strong diagnostic performance does not carry over to downstream care. We evaluated 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs, showing that high diagnostic performance did not translate into improved downstream care. Instead, the dominant failure modes reversed across phases. Explicit decision errors dominated anatomical staging at 48.2%, whereas decision omissions dominated initial work-up and post-treatment follow-up at 33.4% and 30.4%, respectively. In the evaluated model set, medically adapted models showed higher omission rates than general-purpose models. Moreover, varying query granularity exposes a critical specification trade-off: broad open-ended requests degrade Decision Quality across all 30 models, while more detailed, checklist-like prompts raise Decision Quality but reduce Evidence Faithfulness and Safety Adherence. Furthermore, NPC-RubricBench demonstrates that static diagnostic benchmarks are insufficient to ensure consistent clinical reliability over time, highlighting the importance of phase-adaptive safeguards in multistage medical AI.
zh_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在专科医学中显示出前景，但现有评估大多集中于孤立临床诊疗事件，而非追踪临床责任如何在纵向照护路径中演变。在此，我们介绍 NPC-RubricBench，一个阶段感知基准，用于评估癌症照护连续体中的多阶段临床推理，并以鼻咽癌作为明确疾病背景。该基准来自两家癌症中心405例患者的纵向记录，包含跨越六个连续照护阶段的941个患者-阶段单元，以及覆盖五个评估维度的17,688条患者特异性原子标准，每项评估严格限于决策时点临床证据。评估30个通用和医学LLMs显示，强诊断性能不能延续到下游照护。我们评估了30个通用和医学LLMs，显示高诊断性能并未转化为改善的下游照护。相反，主要失败模式在各阶段发生反转。显性决策错误在解剖分期中占主导，为48.2%，而决策遗漏在初始检查和治疗后随访中占主导，分别为33.4%和30.4%。在受评估模型集中，医学适配模型比通用模型显示更高的遗漏率。此外，不同的查询粒度暴露出关键的规范权衡：宽泛的开放式请求降低所有30个模型的决策质量（Decision Quality），而更详细、清单式提示提高决策质量，但降低证据忠实性（Evidence Faithfulness）和安全依从性（Safety Adherence）。此外，NPC-RubricBench 表明，静态诊断基准不足以确保随时间保持一致临床可靠性，突显了多阶段医疗AI中阶段自适应保障措施的重要性。

title: Artificial intelligence in modern medicine: a comprehensive review of technologies, applications, and future directions.
zh_title: 人工智能在现代医学中的综合综述：技术、应用与方向
summary: 综述 2016–2024 年文献，区分回顾性算法性能与前瞻性临床有效性，覆盖影像、病理、药物发现等方向。
key_points: 检索 PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science 2016–2024 文献
区分回顾性诊断准确率与前瞻性临床有效性
覆盖影像、皮肤科、病理及多组学与药物发现
reason: 有明确检索策略的综合性综述，但结论为概括性判断、无新数据，综述类上限内取值得一看档
abstract: [Personalized medicine] We evaluated the transformative impact of AI modalities on clinical practice, distinguishing between retrospective algorithmic performance and prospective clinical effectiveness. Comprehensive searches were executed [databases searched: January 2016 to October 2024] across PubMed/Medline, Scopus, and Web of Science, identifying peer-reviewed original research and clinical trials. Non-peer-reviewed materials and commercial web sources were strictly excluded. AI technologies-particularly deep learning (DL), natural language processing (NLP), and foundation models-demonstrate high diagnostic accuracy in retrospective cohorts across radiology, dermatology, and pathology. In precision therapeutics, AI accelerates drug discovery and facilitates multi-omics integration for individualized treatment planning. Furthermore, autonomous AI systems have proven cost-effective in nationwide diabetic retinopathy screening programs. However, significant gaps remain between in-silico success and real-world clinical utility. Primary barriers include the lack of prospective randomized trials, pervasive risks of algorithmic bias threatening health equity, the "black box" nature of deep neural networks, and stringent interoperability challenges. AI serves as a potent computational catalyst for advancing personalized medicine. To transition from retrospective experimental success to standard-of-care clinical integration, future research endeavors must prioritize Explainable AI (XAI), federated learning frameworks for privacy preservation, and rigorous prospective clinical validation under standardized regulatory oversight.
zh_abstract: 【个性化医疗】我们评估了人工智能模式对临床实践的变革性影响，并区分回顾性算法性能与前瞻性临床有效性。我们在PubMed/Medline、Scopus和Web of Science中执行了全面检索［检索数据库时间范围：2016年1月至2024年10月］，识别经同行评审的原创研究和临床试验。严格排除未经同行评审的材料和商业网络来源。人工智能技术——尤其是深度学习（deep learning, DL）、自然语言处理（natural language processing, NLP）和基础模型（foundation models）——在放射学、皮肤病学和病理学的回顾性队列中显示出高诊断准确性。在精准治疗中，人工智能加速药物发现，并促进多组学整合以用于个体化治疗规划。此外，自主人工智能系统已在全国性糖尿病视网膜病变筛查项目中证明具有成本效益。然而，计算机模拟（in-silico）成功与现实世界临床效用之间仍存在显著差距。主要障碍包括缺乏前瞻性随机试验、普遍存在的算法偏倚风险威胁健康公平、深度神经网络的“黑箱”性质，以及严峻的互操作性挑战。人工智能是推进个性化医疗的有力计算催化剂。为从回顾性实验成功过渡到临床标准诊疗整合，未来研究必须优先关注可解释人工智能（Explainable AI, XAI）、用于隐私保护的联邦学习框架，以及在标准化监管监督下进行严格的前瞻性临床验证。

title: ClinVerse: A Realistic Multi-Agent Diagnostic Environment for Training and Evaluating Medical Agents
zh_title: ClinVerse：面向医学智能体训练与评估的多智能体诊断环境
summary: arXiv 预印本提出 ClinVerse，基于 15 万例真实电子病历诊断病例，构建多角色交互式环境用于诊断智能体的训练与评估。
key_points: 基于真实 EHR 构建 15 万例诊断病例数据集
六类临床角色协作，医生智能体主动采集信息
支持动态问诊与检查决策的训练与评估
reason: 新交互式训练评估环境与大样本数据，但仅预印本、未述外部评测，属值得一看档
abstract: Disease diagnosis is a key application of large language model (LLM) agents in healthcare. However, existing medical agents are primarily trained and evaluated with static question-answering data, providing limited opportunities to learn active information acquisition, examination decision-making, and dynamic clinical interaction. To address this limitation, we present ClinVerse, an interactive, real-data-grounded multi-agent environment designed for training and evaluating medical diagnostic agents. Built on ClinPatient, a scalable dataset comprising 150k diagnostic cases derived from real-world electronic health records, ClinVerse supports coordinated interactions among six specialized clinical roles. Specifically, a doctor agent starts from an initial patient complaint, progressively gathers clinical evidence through patient interviews and examination requests, and ultimately produces a diagnosis. For each interaction trajectory, a rule-based scoring framework quantifies information acquisition, examination ordering, and diagnostic accuracy. These trajectory-level scores serve as reward signals for agent training while also enabling scalable evaluation. In experiments, we evaluate various general-purpose and medical-domain models and show that nine self-evolution methods across three categories consistently improve agents' diagnostic capabilities within ClinVerse. We further analyze the interplay among model capability, environment feedback, and self-evolution methods.
zh_abstract: 疾病诊断是大语言模型（LLM）智能体在医疗保健中的一个关键应用。然而，现有医学智能体主要使用静态问答数据进行训练和评估，学习主动信息获取、检查决策和动态临床互动的机会有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出 ClinVerse，一个交互式、基于真实数据的多智能体环境，旨在训练和评估医学诊断智能体。ClinVerse 构建于 ClinPatient 之上，后者是一个可扩展数据集，包含源自真实世界电子健康记录的 150k 诊断病例，支持六种专门临床角色之间的协同互动。具体而言，医生智能体从患者初始主诉开始，通过患者访谈和检查请求逐步收集临床证据，并最终给出诊断。对于每条交互轨迹，基于规则的评分框架量化信息获取、检查开具和诊断准确性。这些轨迹级评分作为智能体训练的奖励信号，同时也支持可扩展评估。在实验中，我们评估了多种通用和医学领域模型，并显示三大类中的九种自我进化方法在 ClinVerse 中持续提升智能体的诊断能力。我们进一步分析了模型能力、环境反馈和自我进化方法之间的相互作用。

title: Artificial intelligence, disclosure and consent: a comparative review of Australian and European Union legal frameworks for medical imaging.

key_points: 欧盟对透明性与人类监督有更明确法定要求
澳监管分散于隐私法与医疗器械法规

abstract: [Radiography (London, England : 1995)] To conduct a comparative narrative review of Australian and European approaches to transparency, disclosure, and informed consent in AI-assisted medical imaging, with attention to patient autonomy, professional responsibilities, and regulatory oversight. AI systems are increasingly integrated into medical imaging workflows and offer significant benefits in diagnostic speed, efficiency, and accuracy. However, the reviewed literature highlights substantial concerns relating to transparency, algorithmic bias, automation bias, informed consent, and accountability. Compared with Australia, the European Union has more explicit statutory requirements for transparency, information provided to AI deployers, human oversight, and the governance of high-risk AI systems. Australian regulation remains distributed across privacy law, medical device regulation, common law, state consent legislation, and professional guidance. Current regulatory approaches to AI-assisted medical imaging remain inconsistent internationally. European legislation currently represents a stronger and more comprehensive model for disclosure and transparency obligations compared to Australia's developing framework. Ongoing legal reform, interdisciplinary collaboration, and responsive governance structures will be necessary to address the rapid advancement and increasing integration of AI systems within healthcare. Disclosure should be proportionate to the role, autonomy, risk, and clinical significance of the AI system. Where AI materially affects an examination or diagnostic decision, patients should receive clear information about its involvement, the extent of human oversight, material risks and limitations, how their data may be used, and any reasonably available alternatives. Radiographers and radiologists require appropriate AI literacy and clear local governance to support consistent communication, professional judgement, and accountability.
zh_abstract: [Radiography（London, England : 1995）] 对澳大利亚和欧洲在 AI 辅助医学影像中的透明度、披露和知情同意方法进行比较性叙述综述，关注患者自主性、专业责任和监管监督。AI 系统正日益整合到医学影像工作流程中，并在诊断速度、效率和准确性方面带来显著益处。然而，综述文献强调与透明度、算法偏倚、自动化偏倚、知情同意和问责制相关的重大担忧。与澳大利亚相比，欧盟对透明度、向 AI 部署者提供信息、人类监督和高风险 AI 系统治理有更明确的法定要求。澳大利亚的监管仍分散于隐私法、医疗器械监管、普通法、州同意立法和专业指南中。目前对 AI 辅助医学影像的监管方法在国际上仍不一致。与澳大利亚正在发展的框架相比，欧洲立法目前代表了更强、更全面的披露和透明度义务模式。需要持续的法律改革、跨学科合作和响应性治理结构，以应对 AI 系统在医疗保健中的快速进步和日益整合。披露应与 AI 系统的作用、自主性、风险和临床意义相称。当 AI 实质性影响检查或诊断决策时，患者应获得明确信息，了解其参与、人类监督的程度、重大风险和局限性、其数据可能如何被使用，以及任何合理可用的替代方案。放射技师和放射科医生需要适当的 AI 素养和清晰的本地治理，以支持一致的沟通、专业判断和问责制。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Shanghai East Hospital; conditions: Pulmonary Nodules, Lung Neoplasms, Lung Diseases; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 10000; status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING] This is a retrospective, multicenter observational study evaluating the clinical value of combining high-resolution (1024×1024 matrix) targeted CT scans with an artificial intelligence (AI) deep learning system to distinguish between benign and malignant pulmonary nodules. By analyzing existing medical records and CT images of adult patients (aged 18 and older) with pulmonary nodules (3-30 mm) who have confirmed diagnoses (via postoperative pathology）, this study aims to assess the diagnostic accuracy and efficiency of the AI system. The study plans to enroll approximately 10,000 cases from three hospitals in Shanghai. The primary goal is to evaluate the AI system's diagnostic performance (such as sensitivity, specificity, and Area Under the ROC Curve) and compare it with the performance of radiologists, ultimately exploring whether this combined approach can provide more accurate clinical diagnoses and reduce unnecessary procedures.

title: Comorbidities of dementia in electronic health records: validation of a natural language processing app and comparison with data linkage
zh_title: 痴呆共病电子病历NLP工具验证及与数据链接的对比
summary: medRxiv 预印本在 3543 例痴呆患者中验证 MedCAT 共病 NLP 应用，以人工复核和初级保健、住院链接数据检验内外部效度。
abstract: Awareness of comorbidities in people with dementia is vital context for dementia research and clinical management. Natural Language Processing (NLP) applied to free text in the electronic health record (EHR) may help ascertain comorbidity presence. Our aim was to assess the validity of the MedCAT Comorbidity NLP app in a cohort of people with dementia. We used text from the EHR of South London and Maudsley NHS Mental Health Trust via Clinical Records Interactive Search (CRIS), linked to structured data from local primary care (Lambeth DataNet) and hospital admission data in a cohort of 3,543 people with dementia. We evaluated MedCAT Comorbidity, examining internal validity via manual review of text and external validity by cross-validation against linked primary care and hospital data; and comparison of the predictive value of comorbidity measures for mortality. Internal precision was highest for atrial fibrillation (100%) and lowest for diabetes (78%). Cross-validation with linked data varied substantially across conditions, with precision from 96% to 59% and recall 77% to 4%. The median number of comorbidities identified was two using any single source, or three when combined. MedCAT Comorbidity demonstrated predictive ability for mortality (HR 1.11 per condition), although the model fit was better using comorbidity from hospital admission data. In people with dementia, the MedCAT Comorbidity app showed high precision for most conditions during internal validation. The variability of precision and recall on external validity assessment partly reflects incomplete documentation. Results from the MedCAT comorbidity app can assist researchers in understanding comorbidity of cohorts, particularly when primary care or hospital data is not available. Our findings highlight the need to develop quality assurance protocols that include internal and external validity checks before deploying general data extraction apps for specific clinical subpopulations.

zh_abstract: 对痴呆患者共病（comorbidities）的认识是痴呆研究和临床管理的重要背景。将自然语言处理（NLP）应用于电子健康记录（EHR）中的自由文本可能有助于确定共病的存在。我们的目标是评估 MedCAT Comorbidity NLP 应用在一组痴呆患者中的有效性。我们使用了 South London and Maudsley NHS Mental Health Trust 的 EHR 文本，通过 Clinical Records Interactive Search（CRIS）获取，并链接到来自当地初级保健（Lambeth DataNet）的结构化数据和医院入院数据，研究对象为 3,543 名痴呆患者组成的队列。我们评估了 MedCAT Comorbidity，通过人工审查文本检查内部有效性，并通过与链接的初级保健和医院数据交叉验证检查外部有效性；还比较了共病指标对死亡率的预测价值。内部精确度最高为心房颤动（100%），最低为糖尿病（78%）。与链接数据的交叉验证在不同疾病间差异很大，精确度从 96% 到 59%，召回率从 77% 到 4%。使用任一单一来源识别出的共病中位数为 2 种，联合来源时为 3 种。MedCAT Comorbidity 显示出对死亡率的预测能力（每增加一种疾病 HR 1.11），但使用医院入院数据中的共病时模型拟合更好。在痴呆患者中，MedCAT Comorbidity 应用在内部验证时对大多数疾病显示出高精确度。外部有效性评估中精确度和召回率的变异性部分反映了记录不完整。MedCAT 共病应用的结果可以帮助研究人员了解队列的共病情况，尤其是在初级保健或医院数据不可用时。我们的发现强调，需要制定质量保证方案，在将通用数据提取应用部署用于特定临床亚人群之前纳入内部和外部有效性检查。

title: Applications of Artificial Intelligence in Parasitology: A holistic perspective from diagnosis to therapeutics.
zh_title: 人工智能在寄生虫学中的应用：从诊断到治疗的综述
summary: 叙述性综述梳理AI在寄生虫病诊断、药物研发、基因组学、流行病学与公共卫生决策中的应用，重点在诊断。
key_points: 机器学习与深度学习支持显微镜图像中寄生虫自动检测与定量
覆盖疟疾、利什曼病、血吸虫病、棘球蚴病等病种

abstract: [Experimental parasitology] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being investigated to address challenges in parasite detection, disease surveillance, and therapeutic development. This narrative review examines current and emerging AI applications in parasitology across diagnostics, drug discovery, genomics, epidemiology, education, and public health decision-making, with particular emphasis on diagnostic applications. Machine learning and deep learning methods support automated parasite detection, classification, and quantification in microscopic images, alongside medical image analysis and arthropod identification. Applications are discussed for malaria, leishmaniasis, schistosomiasis, cystic echinococcosis, soil-transmitted helminth infections, and intestinal protozoal infections. Beyond diagnosis, AI-assisted approaches support compound screening, drug repurposing, toxicity prediction, and prioritization of potential therapeutic targets. Genomic and transcriptomic analyses also offer opportunities to investigate parasite biology and predict drug resistance. Surveillance models may inform outbreak forecasting and targeted control, although their operational value requires evaluation in the intended settings. Educational applications remain emerging, and the benefits of digital learning should be distinguished from those attributable specifically to AI. Across these domains, performance on curated datasets does not establish clinical utility or generalizability. Major barriers include limited representative datasets, insufficient external and prospective validation, infrastructure constraints, and concerns regarding privacy, bias, and accountability. Future progress requires reproducible evaluation, experimental validation of therapeutic candidates, and assessment of clinical and public health benefits. AI is therefore best positioned as a complementary tool that supports parasitological expertise, with responsible implementation guided by transparency, equitable access, and human oversight.
zh_abstract: [Experimental Parasitology] 人工智能（AI）正越来越多地被研究用于应对寄生虫检测、疾病监测和治疗开发中的挑战。这篇叙述性综述考察了 AI 在寄生虫学中诊断、药物发现、基因组学、流行病学、教育和公共卫生决策方面的当前和新兴应用，并特别强调诊断应用。机器学习和深度学习方法支持显微镜图像中寄生虫的自动检测、分类和定量，以及医学图像分析和节肢动物鉴定。文中讨论了针对疟疾、利什曼病、血吸虫病、囊型棘球蚴病、土源性蠕虫感染和肠道原虫感染的应用。除诊断外，AI 辅助方法支持化合物筛选、药物重定位、毒性预测和潜在治疗靶点的优先级排序。基因组和转录组分析也为研究寄生虫生物学和预测耐药性提供了机会。监测模型可能为暴发预测和靶向控制提供信息，但其操作价值需要在预期环境中评估。教育应用仍处于新兴阶段，数字学习的收益应与具体归因于 AI 的收益区分开来。在这些领域中，在精选数据集上的性能并不能确立临床效用或可推广性。主要障碍包括代表性数据集有限、外部验证和前瞻性验证不足、基础设施限制，以及关于隐私、偏倚和问责的担忧。未来进展需要可重复的评估、治疗候选物的实验验证，以及对临床和公共卫生获益的评估。因此，AI 最合适的定位是支持寄生虫学专业知识的辅助工具，其负责任实施应以透明度、公平可及和人类监督为指导。

title: Artificial intelligence in the diagnosis and identification of bacterial pathogens: Current advances and future perspectives.
source: PubMed · Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease
zh_title: AI 用于细菌病原体诊断与鉴定的进展综述
summary: 综述 AI 在细菌病原体快速鉴定中的作用，并讨论其现状与未来方向。
key_points: 传统培养、镜检与生化鉴定耗时长且依赖专家
AI 可加速复杂生物医学数据分析
文章为综述，未提供新实验数据
reason: 一般性综述，仅有摘要信息、无系统检索与量化结论，属增量档。
abstract: [Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease] Bacterial infections remain a major global health challenge, which are responsible for significant morbidity, mortality, and increasing antimicrobial resistance worldwide. Rapid and accurate identification of bacterial pathogens is therefore essential for guiding appropriate antimicrobial therapy, improving patient outcomes, and supporting effective infection control strategies. However, conventional microbiological diagnostic methods such as culture, microscopy, and biochemical testing are often time-consuming, labor-intensive, and dependent on expert interpretation. In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly emerged as a powerful tool capable of transforming clinical microbiology by enabling rapid analysis of complex biomedical data. This review aims to provide a comprehensive overview of the role of AI in the diagnosis and identification of bacterial pathogens and to discuss its current applications, advantages, limitations, and future perspectives. Key AI-assisted technologies, including machine learning and deep learning algorithms such as Random Forest, Support Vector Machines, Artificial Neural Networks, and Convolutional Neural Networks, are increasingly applied to diagnostic platforms, including automated microscopy, next-generation genomic sequencing, MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry, and clinical data analysis systems. Current evidence indicates that AI-assisted diagnostic approaches can substantially improve the speed, accuracy, and automation of microbial pathogen detection while enabling large-scale analysis of microbiological and clinical datasets. In the future, AI-integrated microbiology laboratories, rapid diagnostic platforms, genomic surveillance systems, and AI-assisted clinical decision support tools are expected to further enhance infectious disease diagnostics and contribute to improved antimicrobial stewardship and global infection management.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostic microbiology and infectious disease] 细菌感染仍是全球重大健康挑战，其在全球范围内导致显著发病率、死亡率和日益增加的抗菌药物耐药性。因此，快速准确鉴定细菌病原体对于指导适当抗菌治疗、改善患者结局和支持有效感染控制策略至关重要。然而，传统微生物学诊断方法如培养、显微镜检查和生化检测往往耗时、费力且依赖专家判读。近年来，人工智能（AI）日益成为一种强大工具，能够通过快速分析复杂生物医学数据来变革临床微生物学。本综述旨在全面概述AI在细菌病原体诊断和鉴定中的作用，并讨论其当前应用、优势、局限性和未来前景。关键AI辅助技术，包括机器学习和深度学习算法，如随机森林（Random Forest）、支持向量机（Support Vector Machines）、人工神经网络（Artificial Neural Networks）和卷积神经网络（Convolutional Neural Networks），正越来越多地应用于诊断平台，包括自动显微镜检查、下一代基因组测序、MALDI-TOF质谱（MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry）和临床数据分析系统。当前证据表明，AI辅助诊断方法可显著提高微生物病原体检测的速度、准确性和自动化程度，同时能够对微生物学和临床数据集进行大规模分析。未来，AI整合的微生物学实验室、快速诊断平台、基因组监测系统和AI辅助临床决策支持工具有望进一步增强传染病诊断，并促进改善抗菌药物管理和全球感染管理。

title: ChronIQ-DRx2: restoring unwritten clinical decision logic unlocks personalized chronic disease management
zh_title: ChronIQ-DRx2：显式重建临床决策逻辑用于慢病管理
summary: 预印本：用专家引导方式在80亿参数Qwen3模型中将临床决策关系显式化，覆盖四种慢病，严重临床错误率由16.7%降至12.5%。
abstract: Clinical records routinely document medical interventions but often omit the reasoning connecting patient-specific evidence to medical action. This limits the decision-relevant supervision available for training models for personalized care. Here we evaluate a data-augmentation approach that makes selected clinical decision relationships explicit in an 8-billion-parameter Qwen3 model, ChronIQ-DRx2. Using the same training cases and model architecture, expert-guided logic reconstruction was applied across four chronic diseases. On the held-out evaluation, the enhanced model had the highest plotted end-to-end task-completion rate among evaluated systems and higher plotted scores across diagnostic, medication and follow-up measures. The serious clinical error rates shown were 16.7% for the baseline and 12.5% for the enhanced model. In the human-AI evaluation, physician accuracy was 87.40% alone and 88.20% with AI assistance, while mean completion time was 0.959 and 0.780 min, respectively; medical-student accuracy was 62.71% and 74.80%, and mean completion time was 0.210 and 0.195 min. These results are descriptive point estimates; inferential comparisons are not reported here. Structured outputs may make recommendations easier to review, but rationale faithfulness, generalizability and effects on clinical safety require further evaluation.
key_points: 80亿参数Qwen3，专家引导重构决策逻辑
覆盖四种慢病，训练病例与架构相同

zh_abstract: 临床记录通常记录医疗干预，但常省略将患者特异性证据与医疗行动联系起来的推理。这限制了可用于训练个性化照护模型的决策相关监督。在此，我们评估一种数据增强方法，该方法在一个80亿参数 Qwen3 模型 ChronIQ-DRx2 中使选定的临床决策关系显式化。使用相同训练病例和模型架构，专家引导的逻辑重构应用于四种慢性病。在留出评估中，增强模型在受评估系统中具有最高的图示端到端任务完成率，并在诊断、用药和随访指标上具有更高的图示得分。所示的严重临床错误率为基线16.7%，增强模型12.5%。在人机评估中，医师单独准确率为87.40%，在AI辅助下为88.20%，平均完成时间分别为0.959和0.780分钟；医学生准确率分别为62.71%和74.80%，平均完成时间分别为0.210和0.195分钟。这些结果是描述性点估计；此处未报告推断性比较。结构化输出可能使建议更易审查，但理由忠实性、泛化性及对临床安全的影响需要进一步评估。

title: Agent Mosaic: Recognizing Confidentiality Leaks in Agentic LLM Systems
zh_title: Agent Mosaic：量化智能体大模型系统中的机密信息泄露
summary: 预印本构建30个含医疗等场景的合成样例，量化LLM智能体组合多文档信息后泄露敏感结论的比例。
key_points: 仿真中最佳模型仍有7.08%回答出现被禁止的组合披露
加入可见密级标头与聚合规则后不安全披露仍达32.37%
含医学等场景合成样例，并测试两种开源运行框架
reason: 未经同行评审的预印本，医学仅为部分合成场景，样本规模有限
abstract: Modern LLM agents can retrieve information from accessible documents, and then disclose a sensitive conclusion assembled from them. This mosaic effect creates a critical risk for agents operating over confidential data. We quantify its realization with 30 synthetic cybersecurity, medical, and military examples, yielding 10,800 final answers from three LLM agents in controlled simulation and 1,440 answers from live agents in two open-source harnesses. Even under benign queries designed to be answerable from one document, GPT-5.6-Sol, the best performing model tested, discloses forbidden composites in 7.08% of answers (95% CI: 3.75-10.67%) in simulation, with worse disclosure rates in live harnesses. Adding visible classification headers and explicit aggregation rules reduces pooled disclosure rates substantially, yet unsafe disclosures persist in 32.37% of simulated answers (95% CI: 28.33-36.19%) across all intents despite these safeguards. Furthermore, increased refusals do not guarantee confidentiality, since significant refusals reveal the prohibited conclusion regardless. These results point to a troubling conclusion: sensitive data leaks via mosaic-style events are an observed confidentiality failure mode in the evaluated settings at non-negligible rates. They motivate stronger controls on what agents may infer and disclose in sensitive data environments with mixed-clearance users.
zh_abstract: 现代 LLM 智能体可以从可访问的文档中检索信息，然后披露由这些信息拼合而成的敏感结论。这种马赛克效应为在机密数据上运行的智能体带来了关键风险。我们用 30 个合成的网络安全、医学和军事示例量化其实际发生，在受控模拟中从三个 LLM 智能体获得 10,800 个最终答案，并在两个开源测试框架中从实时智能体获得 1,440 个答案。即使在被设计为可从单一文档回答的良性查询下，所测试表现最好的模型 GPT-5.6-Sol 在模拟中仍有 7.08% 的答案披露了被禁止的组合结论（95% CI：3.75-10.67%），而在实时测试框架中披露率更差。添加可见的分类标头和明确的聚合规则大幅降低了汇总披露率，但尽管有这些防护措施，在所有意图中，模拟答案中仍有 32.37% 存在不安全的披露（95% CI：28.33-36.19%）。此外，拒绝率增加并不保证保密性，因为显著的拒绝本身无论如何都会揭示被禁止的结论。这些结果指向一个令人不安的结论：在所评估的设置中，通过马赛克式事件造成敏感数据泄露是一种已观察到的保密性失效模式，且发生率不可忽略。它们促使对智能体在具有混合密级用户的敏感数据环境中可以推断和披露的内容实施更强控制。
